experiment.name: planner-residuals
experiment.question: Can two general-purpose planner clauses (no-echo-offtopic, restart-on-confusion) close the planner-side interrupt residuals and generalize to a fresh held-out set?
experiment.metric: qa-bench hard-PASS rate (grade.ts: deterministic gates + gemini-3.5-flash judge); 11-set shown for variance, held-out T7-T12 for verdict
experiment.threshold_rule: Strictly dominate dev (fix targets, regress 0) AND regress 0 on fresh held-out T7-T12.

verdict.rationale: The 11-set does not discriminate (round 1 maxed it; both arms 9.7/11). Round 2's win is the no-echo-offtopic clause: held-out off-topic slice 0/2 -> 1/2 (T9 fixed), aggregate 3/6 -> 4/6, 0 regressions. n=6 held-out -> wide CIs (directional, not powered). restart-on-confusion is kept as general-true + harmless (latency-flat) but benchmark-neutral. Ship iter2. Residuals: C7 climax-leak, C5 noise, T5-qa reassurance, T7 trivia (judge-borderline).
